Author: John Wilson (jdw-ss)
Name: GC Supply Helper
Description:
Computes the raw-material shopping list for FFXIV's daily Grand Company Supply and Provisioning missions. Reads today's 11 turn-ins (3 gatherers + 8 crafters), recursively expands each required item through the Lumina Recipe sheet down to gathered / vendor / drop leaves, and surfaces both a per-mission breakdown and a single aggregate list that calls out materials needed by multiple classes.

Populates the moment you open either the in-game Timers panel (System → Online → Timers) or the Grand Company Personnel Officer's Supply List — whichever you reach first in your daily routine.

Usage:
  /gcs    - open / close the main window
Punchline: Today's shopping list for all 11 Grand Company daily turn-ins.
